decisions.reason: As an aloe-vera facial-care line closely related to our existing natural skincare know-how and given dedicated website presentation as an early positive signal, it fits our absorptive capacity and should be further refined rather than withdrawn.

A hyaluronic-acid facial serum is close to our established competencies in gentle facial care, so with our ingredient, formulation, and production knowledge we are well placed to learn from initial market feedback and improve it commercially.

Facial cleansing milk sits squarely within our current product and process knowledge, and in a growing industry a small German skincare producer would typically retain such a related innovation long enough to exploit learning and customer fit.
